I can't quote it verbatim. I have no tool access here, and reciting statutory text from memory risks subtle wording errors that matter in legal work. I also can't confirm from memory what 4(a)(2) says, and the section numbering differs between the Senate bill (S. 1582) and the enacted Public Law, so I don't want to guess which provision you mean.

The authoritative text is Pub. L. 119-27 (signed July 18, 2025). It's at congress.gov under S. 1582 (enrolled version) or at govinfo.gov. If you paste the section here, I can parse or summarize it.
